newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: RAFINERSKA RENEWS CRUDE SUPPLIES TO CHEMOPETROL.
newsitem.headline: RAFINERSKA RENEWS CRUDE SUPPLIES TO CHEMOPETROL.

text.p: Czech Ceska Rafinerska a.s. on Tuesday renewed crude supplies to the ethylene plant of Chemopetrol a.s. near Litvinov after two fires struck Rafinerska's Litvinov refinery in recent days.
In a joint statement, Rafinerska and Chemopetrol said the important lines providing crude products to the Chemopetrol "are in full opertion".
"Also put into operation were lines for ethylbenzinol for Kaucuk Kralupy ," the statment said.
It said damage is still being estimated at the Litvinov refinery, after the second fire in eight days struck the plant this past weekend.
A fire broke out on Sunday night in a furnace of a cracking unit as crude flow resumed after an eight-day stoppage.
Rafinerska closed the cracking unit but crude processing, which was halted after the first fire, would continue.
Oil flow had been halted after a blaze in another part of the refinery began on November 23 and lasted for more than two days.
The latest fire was put out several hours after it started.
